page: Microsoft Azure NC4as_T4_v3 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine belonging to the NCASv3_T4 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an AMD processor with an x86_64 architecture and provides 4 dedicated vCPUs. The system is equipped with 28.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 7.0 GB of RAM per core.

Acceleration is delivered via a single integrated NVIDIA T4 GPU with 15 GB of dedicated VRAM. For local storage, the instance includes a 180 GB SSD and is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage volumes. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Due to the dedicated hardware allocation, this server offers predictable compute resources for workloads requiring GPU acceleration, such as machine learning inference, lightweight video transcoding, and CUDA-based parallel processing. However, users should note that advanced CPU instruction sets like AVX-512, AMX, and SHA-NI are not enabled on this instance type, which may limit performance for CPU-only cryptographic or vector operations. The instance represents a balanced entry point for GPU-accelerated workloads where a single NVIDIA T4 GPU and moderate system memory are sufficient.
